grouping.fallback: Opening IDs without an explicit family remain separate groups.

limitations: Recorded settings and replayed legal moves do not attest the executable or process identity; missing execution provenance remains unknown.
Selected handicap games are a pipeline diagnostic, not a representative population of ordinary or upgraded-piece positions.
Samples from the same game and related openings are dependent; use game-balanced weights and grouped validation/resampling.
Material-stable windows filter recent/nearby captures and promotions but do not establish tactical quietness.
Ordinary family counts plus upgrade bonuses are model features, not intrinsic exchange prices or engine MG/EG parameters.
Each sampled game has total weight one; games with no accepted positions are retained in coverage but contribute no fitting weight.
2 color pairs contribute samples from only one game; sampled evidence is not fully color-paired.

method.ridgeScale: mean game-weighted loss; penalty on standardized slopes
method.weighting: each sampled game has unit total weight
method.normalizationThreshold: Conservative reporting policy, not a confidence guarantee or a reason to generate more games automatically.
method.regularizationCaveat: Ridge produces finite exploratory slopes even for some separated outcomes; absence of a perfect-classification flag does not exclude quasi-separation.
method.interpretation: Exploratory outcome-predictive coefficients conditional on this selected dataset and playing policy; not intrinsic or causal piece values.

bootstrap.interpretation: Exploratory conditional whole-family percentile stability; failed and unsupported fits are counted, not hidden. Not a universal confidence interval or representative material calibration.
